subject: Momentum brief: top OKR movements, blockers & QBR asks
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Momentum brief: top OKR movements, blockers & QBR asks

Team —

Quick weekly snapshot ahead of QBR prep. Short bullets so this can slot into the Friday leadership packet. Will attach a 2-slide summary and the small-signal dashboard.

Wins:
- Inference throughput: Dedicated pipeline 3.0 reduced p99 latency by 18% for long-seq workloads (A/B test on chat-backend).
- Sales: Acme Analytics proof-of-concept completed; they signed PO for Dedicated pilot (see attached).
- Platform: KV cache rollout (canary) reduced token spend by ~9% for API baseline traffic.

Risks / near-term concerns:
- Infra runway: we need to confirm a short-term GPU reserve to sustain burst testing for Q4 demos — estimate ~2 weeks of reserved capacity at current burn.
- Quality drift: recent quantization profile for 2.7B shows a slight BLEU-style hit on composite prompts; experimentation needs one more round before we endorse in Dedicated.
- Support load: onboarding Acme will require SOC evidence and a small audit packet; CS will need help from Security to meet their timeline (Nov 18).

Asks (action owners & deadlines):
- Karthik: confirm infra reserve proposal (cost delta + procurement ETA) by Wed EOD (11/03).
- Laura: add two slides on GTM ask for the QBR (Acme pilot + target ARR motion) by Thu 11/04 noon.
- Jonas: consolidate the reliability SLO slide and include p99 comparison graph (attached) by Thu EOD.
- Security & CS (cc’ing separately): compile SOC evidence checklist and target deliverable date for Acme by 11/10.

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_2027_Momentum_Slides.pdf (pptx, 3.2MB)], [Attachment: OKR_signal_dashboard.png (png, 420KB)]

Notes: planning to synthesize replies into a single two-slide leader brief on Friday morning. If any ask is not feasible, flag here so I can reassign.

—Mateo
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum brief: top OKR movements, blockers & QBR asks

Thanks Mateo — useful, short, and actionable. Two quick requests:

1) Can you add a one-line context for the BLEU-style hit (which workload and expected customer-facing impact)? That will help frame the risk in the QBR slide.
2) For Acme’s SOC ask: please include any gaps we already know about (e.g., retention policy docs, encryption-in-transit attestation). If Security can point to the exact artifacts they need, CS can parallelize work.

I’ll draft the GTM slides and drop into the shared deck by Thu morning — will call out the ARR assumptions.

—Laura
VP, Go-to-Market
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum brief: top OKR movements, blockers & QBR asks

On Wed, Nov 2, 2027 at 10:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Mateo — useful, short, and actionable. Two quick requests:

Quick update on infra reserve:
- Finance signoff for short-term reserve is likely but we need an explicit procurement ticket and a cost delta sign-off. I can get the procurement ETA by EOD Wed (11/03) if Finance confirms the approach.
- Estimate: additional reserved capacity (2 weeks burst) ~= $48k USD. I'm lobbying to cover half from Q4 launch promo budget; will update.

On the quantization note: that BLEU-style delta is concentrated on the summarization prompt class (internal eval set: NEWS-4k). It is measurable but minor for short prompts; it hits the coherence of long-sequence summaries more. We are scheduling another retrain-tune pass this week (INF-8421) — Jonas, can you confirm the rollout gate?

Karthik
Head of Platform
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum brief: top OKR movements, blockers & QBR asks

Thanks — quick note. I can gate the quantization rollout but will need the retrain-tune artifacts and a validation checklist. Starting a short canary tomorrow; if pass criteria met (precision and hallucination delta thresholds), we greenlight a limited rollout for Dedicated.

Can we table a 10-minute alignment during the Friday exec sync to confirm procurement cover and gate criteria? If so, I’ll add a slide with the gate checklist.

On Thu, Nov 4, 2027 at 09:02 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> [Adding preliminary acceptance criteria below for visibility:]
> - Repro baseline on NEWS-4k; summary coherence score >= 0.92 of baseline
> - No >2% regression in p95/p99 across long seq regression harness
> - Full KV cache compat smoke tests pass in staging

Jonas
VP, Reliability

Appended consolidated actions for QBR packet and follow-ups. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.

Consolidated actions (owner — deliverable — date):
- Karthik — procurement ticket + cost delta memo (include finance contact) — 11/03 (updated: procurement ticket created; awaiting finance signoff by 11/05).
- Laura — GTM two slides + ARR assumptions — 11/04 (done; placed in shared deck: /drive/qbr/2027/momentum).
- Jonas — gate checklist slide + canary results summary — 11/04 (canary started; results pending, will present Friday).
- Security — SOC evidence checklist + retention policy doc pointer — 11/10 (Security copied; please confirm deliverables).

I’ll fold the attached slides and the updated canary snapshot into the final leader brief on Friday morning. If anything shifts, flag it in this thread.
